title: Custom Plate Filling Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: Download the custom labware package (JSON files) that define the Agilent 48‑well reservoir and the MicroAmp Endura 96‑well plate for use with the OT‑2.

steps.title: Upload labware definition to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons OT‑2 App, upload the downloaded JSON labware definition files so the robot recognises the 48‑well reservoir and 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the Python protocol that automates distribution of assays from the 48‑well reservoir to nine 96‑well plates into the OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the deck exactly as described:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1‑9: MicroAmp Endura 96‑well plate (one plate per slot).
Slot 11: Agile (as indicated in the protocol).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate all labware, the tip rack, and the Opentrons P50 multi‑channel pipette (compatible with 50/300 µL tips). Follow the support articles for tip‑calibration if needed.

steps.title: Set run parameters
steps.instruction: In the protocol UI, specify the starting tip‑column and the number of runs; each run will fill all nine plates from the 48‑well reservoir.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App. The robot will use the P50 multi‑channel pipette and 50/300 µL tips to transfer assay from the Agilent 48‑well reservoir to the nine MicroAmp Endura plates. After each set of nine plates, the OT‑2 will flash, pause, and prompt you to replace the plates before continuing.
